fields.name: ACCT-ID
fields.description: Account identifier — 11-digit unsigned integer stored in DISPLAY format.

fields.name: ACCT-CURR-BAL
fields.description: Current account balance. Signed zoned-decimal with 2 implied decimal places and trailing sign overpunch.

fields.name: ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
fields.description: Credit limit. Signed zoned-decimal with 2 implied decimal places and trailing sign overpunch.

fields.name: ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT
fields.description: Cash advance credit limit. Signed zoned-decimal with 2 implied decimal places and trailing sign overpunch.

fields.name: ACCT-OPEN-DATE
fields.description: Account open date stored as a character string (observed format: YYYY-MM-DD).

fields.name: ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE
fields.description: Account expiration date (note: typo 'EXPIRAION' preserved from original copybook).

fields.name: ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
fields.description: Current billing cycle credit total. Signed zoned-decimal with trailing overpunch.

fields.name: ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
fields.description: Current billing cycle debit total. Signed zoned-decimal with trailing overpunch.

fields.name: FILLER
fields.description: Reserved/unused bytes to pad the record to 300 bytes. Excluded from the PySpark DataFrame.
